title: Three (3D Experience Gallery)
bulletPoints: Architected a high-performance 3D gallery SPA using React Three Fiber, bypassing React state with mutable refs for direct WebGL context updates to ensure fluid animation loops.
Developed custom GLSL shaders and integrated Rapier physics to implement complex, interactive real-time scenes, including particle morphing and rigid-body simulations.
Engineered procedural terrain generation by utilizing Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) and dynamic multi-layered shader materials.
Optimized application scalability and stability by modularizing 3D scenes for lazy loading and enforcing rigorous WebGL memory management to prevent memory leaks.

title: Alaska
bulletPoints: Architected a highly scalable, decoupled real-time chat system utilizing Nginx load balancing, a Node.js Chat Gateway with Socket.io, and background workers polling Redis Streams for high-throughput message persistence.
Implemented a Suffix Automaton (SAM) data structure on the frontend for linear-time path overlap matching, offloading compute to significantly reduce backend server overhead.
Optimized PostgreSQL database performance using PgBouncer for connection multiplexing and worker-driven batched bulk inserts, successfully sustaining 14,000 concurrent WebSocket connections.
Built an interactive commuter route-matching interface with React, Mapbox GL, and Zustand, optimizing memory and data transmission by mapping 271 metro station strings to unique integers.
